export_onnx_model: export a PyTorch model to ONNX format by tracing it with sample inputs
export_caffe2_detection_model: export a caffe2-compatible Detectron2 model to caffe2 protobuf format via ONNX
run_and_save_graph: run a caffe2 model on given inputs and save the computation graph with blob shapes
_assign_device_option: assign GPU device options to ONNX-exported Caffe2 network operations
_op_stats: generate operator statistics showing type counts from a Caffe2 net definition
